name: Nullframe SynthBody Adaptive Full Rig
description:
Designed from the ground up for synthetic body proportions — elongated limb ratios, non-standard torso geometry, and the absence of biological thermal needs. The top is a structured open-panel vest in gunmetal tensile mesh, exposing the synthetic chassis deliberately while framing it as aesthetic. Lower garment is a wide-leg drape pant in liquid-black synth-silk, cut for digitigrade or elongated leg configurations with a floating waistband that anchors via tension rather than belt loops.

Footwear is a wrap-sole platform in molded carbon, accommodating non-standard foot geometries. An optional shoulder mantle in translucent smoked polymer clips magnetically to the vest. No zippers — all closures are magnetic or tension-based for synthetic-safe donning. Colorway: gunmetal, black, and smoked translucent.
functionality: Tension and magnetic closures for synthetic-safe dressing, floating waistband for non-standard torso geometry, digitigrade-compatible pant cut, chassis-exposure vest panels as intentional design, magnetic shoulder mantle attachment.
what_it_says: I am not approximating human — I am presenting what I actually am, and it is deliberate.
worn_by: synthetic beings of varied chassis types
story_hooks: A synthetic street artist was photographed in this rig at an unauthorized gallery installation — the corponation that owns the building wants them found.
The tension-anchor waistband system was reverse-engineered from medical immobilization equipment; Nullframe has never acknowledged the origin.
A human buyer purchased this rig to pass as synthetic in a district where synthetics have legal protections humans don't.

physical_description.visual_profile: A deliberately exposed, architectural silhouette designed for synthetic bodies with exaggerated proportions. The open-panel vest frames the chassis like a sculptural display, while the wide-leg drape creates an ethereal, almost liquid lower half. Reads as intentionally inhuman—a celebration of synthetic form rather than camouflage.
physical_description.fit: Precision-engineered for non-standard anatomy: elongated limbs, digitigrade stance, extended torso geometry. The vest sits rigid and geometric; the pants drape with intentional excess, floating at the waist via tension mechanics. Accommodates servo lines, wiring, and modular components.
physical_description.primary_material: Gunmetal tensile mesh (vest panels), liquid-black synth-silk (pants), molded carbon platform sole, translucent smoked polymer (optional mantle)
physical_description.texture: Mesh is smooth with subtle gridwork pattern; synth-silk has a luxurious fluid drape with minimal memory; carbon sole is matte industrial; smoked polymer is semi-translucent with soft frosted finish
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray, liquid black, and smoked translucent polymer accents. Cool, neutral palette emphasizing sleek synthetic aesthetic.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic snap system on vest panels, tension-anchored floating waistband (no loops), magnetic attachment points for optional shoulder mantle. Zero friction-based fasteners.
distinctive_features: Open-panel architecture deliberately exposing synthetic chassis as design intent
Floating tension-anchor waistband compatible with non-standard torso geometry
Digitigrade-compatible pant cut with integrated sole wrap system
Optional translucent smoked polymer shoulder mantle with magnetic clip mounts
Magnetic-only closure system (synthetic-body friendly, zero pinch risk)
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 luxury / specialized synthetic market. Bespoke proportional engineering and advanced material selection signal corpo-level resources or high-tier synthetic community status.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by synthetic sentients, high-end androids, or those who've undergone extreme corporeal modification. Signals ownership of custom-built synthetic bodies, corp-grade augmentation, or deliberate posthuman identity. Not camouflage—assertion.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine and maintained; synthetic bodies don't weather fabrics normally. Surfaces show deliberate design wear (if any) as intentional aesthetic, never accidental damage.
